meta.source: droid-manual-blue-7 (ch. 6 controllers, 7 G8, 8 X7, 9 MASTER18, 10 R2M/R2C, 14 hardware) + documented/reasonable pitch values where the manual gives no millimetre positions; see per-controller `notes`
meta.chain_gaps_note: assumption: Eurorack panels mount adjacent with ~0.5 mm tolerance gap; the manual specifies no fixed master->controller spacing (ribbon cable, arbitrary length), so the model renders the chain contiguously with the inter-module gap
meta.fallback_note: unknown/missing controller type falls back to 5 HP (average controller width) + warn, per design D6

grids.note: cols 0-1 = inputs I1..I8, cols 2-3 = outputs O1..O8; inputs numbered down the left column (I1..I4) then the right (I5..I8)

master.notes: Manual-documented: 8 HP; 8 CV in (I1..I8) + 8 CV out (O1..O8); 16 full-color LEDs R1..R16 arranged 4x4, rows 1-2 = input LEDs, rows 3-4 = output LEDs (register table); SD reload button. Assumed: pitches/margins (LED pitch 8 mm, jack pitch 8.5x13 mm, 0.1" side margin, 12 mm screw zones).

master18.notes: Manual-documented: 6 HP; 8 CV out (O1..O8), 2 gate inputs, 4 gate outputs (G1.1..G1.4 on the master18, see G8 chapter register numbering), MicroSD reload button. No LEDs (manual lists none). Assumed: pitches/margins; gate in/out jack grouping (right column).

grids.note: tristate gate jacks (input or output)
one LED above each jack; R17..R48 for G8s 1-4 (offset by chain slot)

g8.notes: Manual-documented: 4 HP; 8 tristate gate jacks (G registers, dot notation per chain slot), 8 multicolor LEDs (R17..R24 first G8). Assumed: pitches/margins; LED above each jack.

grids.note: 3-position USB switch (left SD / middle off / right MIDI)
gate outputs G9..G12 (master); G1.5..G1.8 with a master18
R49..R56 for X7s 1-4 (offset by chain slot)

x7.notes: Manual-documented: 4 HP; 7 ports (USB-C, MIDI TRS in/out, 4 gate outputs G9..G12), 3-position USB switch, 8 LEDs (R49..R56). USB-C + MIDI TRS jacks are physical ports, not patch-addressable cells — noted, not modelled. Assumed: pitches/margins.

grids.note: 3.5 mm serial bridge jacks — transparent to patches, no tokens

r2m.notes: Manual-documented: 2 HP; 2 serial line drivers (3.5 mm stereo patch-cable bridge, transparent to patches — no hardware tokens exist). Assumed: pitches/margins.

grids.note: 3.5 mm serial bridge jacks — transparent to patches, no tokens

r2c.notes: Manual-documented: 2 HP; 2 serial line drivers (3.5 mm stereo patch-cable bridge, transparent to patches — no hardware tokens exist). Assumed: pitches/margins.

grids.note: one centred column (was a two-cell row)
LED centred in each button

p2b8.notes: Manual-documented: 5 HP; two pots P1.1..P1.2 stacked in one centred 12x12 column at 24.7 mm pitch, eight buttons B1.1..B1.8 on a 2x4 grid of 9x9 cells at 12.6 x 15.0 mm pitch with an LED (3x3, L1.1..L1.8) centred in each button; row-wise button numbering. Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.

grids.note: one centred column (was two columns x two rows)
LED centred in each button

p4b2.notes: Manual-documented: 5 HP; four pots P1.1..P1.4 stacked in one centred 12x12 column at 24.8 mm pitch (same pot class as P2B8), two buttons B1.1..B1.2 on one 9x9 row at y 113.4 with an LED (3x3) centred in each. Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.

grids.note: big pots, one centred column
small pots, 2 x 4 matrix kept

p10.notes: Manual-documented: 5 HP; two big pots P1.1..P1.2 stacked in one centred 12x12 column at 24.8 mm pitch and eight small pots P1.3..P1.10 on a 2x4 matrix of 9x9 cells at 12.6 x 15.1 mm pitch; row-wise numbering (faceplate text-image shows 3..10 in 2 columns). Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.

grids.note: 8-position rotary switches, one centred column
3-position toggle switches, same 2 x 4 grid as the P10 small pots

s10.notes: Manual-documented: 5 HP; two 8-position rotary switches S1.1..S1.2 stacked in one centred 12x12 column at 24.8 mm pitch and eight 3-position switches S1.3..S1.10 on a 2x4 matrix of 8x12 cells at 12.6 x 15.1 mm pitch; row-wise numbering. Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.

grids.note: 20 mm travel sliders (P registers); LED inside slider
LED inside each slider cap
3-position toggle switches

p8s8.notes: Manual-documented: 8 HP; eight Alpha sliders 20 mm travel (P1.1..P1.8, slider LEDs L1.1..L1.8 defaulting to position), eight 3-pos toggle switches below (S1.1..S1.8). Assumed: pitches/margins; slider pitch 4.35 mm (dense 1 HP-class packing).

grids.note: 4 cols x 8 rows per the manual faceplate text-image (buttons labelled 1..32 row-wise; 'a column of eight buttons')
LED inside each button; 4 brightness levels only

b32.notes: Manual-documented: 10 HP; 32 buttons B1.1..B1.32 with LEDs L1.1..L1.32, faceplate labelled 1..32 as 4 cols x 8 rows (resolves the 8x4 orientation conflict). Assumed: pitches/margins.

grids.note: 96-step encoders, one centred column at x 15.24 (was a four-cell row)
push button integrated in each encoder

e4.notes: Manual-documented: 6 HP; four 96-step encoders E1.1..E1.4 stacked in one centred 7x7 column at 27.8 mm pitch (x 15.24), push buttons B1.1..B1.4 (3x3) in the encoder shafts, and a square of 32 multicolor LEDs around each encoder (4 rings x 32 = 128; L1.1..L1.128 as rings 1..32, 33..64, ... per encoder) — 9 LEDs per side at 2.76 mm pitch with 1.8 mm cells, a ~23.88 mm square centred on its encoder. Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.

grids.note: ALPS 60 mm action motorized faders (P registers)
touch plates below each fader (B registers)
RGB LED below each touch plate (L + R registers)

m4.notes: Manual-documented: 14 HP; four ALPS 60 mm motor faders (P1.1..P1.4), touch plate with integrated RGB LED below each fader (B1.1..B1.4, L1.1..L1.4, R1.1..R1.4). Assumed: pitches/margins (fader pitch 17 mm).

grids.note: 8 push buttons; display band above the grid; no LEDs on the buttons (manual silent)
rotary encoder below the button grid, on its centre axis (same class as E4); was beside the buttons

db8e.notes: Manual-documented: 6 HP; display (D, not rendered — non-goal), eight push buttons B1.1..B1.8 on a 2x4 grid of 9x9 cells at 15.2 x 15.1 mm pitch (x 7.9/23.1, y 41.4..86.7), and one rotary encoder E1.1 (7x7, same class as E4) BELOW the button grid at (15.24, 108.1) with its 32-LED square (L1.1..L1.32 — 9 per side at 2.76 mm pitch, 1.8 mm cells, ~23.88 mm); the display area in the upper region is reserved, not modelled. Measured (not assumed) from the manual faceplate images with the calibration factor: 5 HP panels 224 px <-> 25.4 mm (8.82 px/mm), 6 HP panels 225 px <-> 30.48 mm (7.38 px/mm), both confirmed on the 1132 px <-> 128.5 mm height axis; centres good to ~0.3 mm.
